quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 collective (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 collective results briefing: board secretary Chen Zhenyin said 12-inch high-current ion implanters are in batch delivery to several leading domestic IC makers with repeat orders, while mid-current and high-energy models are in development; ion-implanter output currently relies on leased plants, which constrains capacity until the Shanghai project is built; parts localisation has reached 70% to 80%. CFO Wang Huaixu said the Beijing subsidiary and Tianjin phase 2 are complete and releasing capacity. Chairman Wang Tongqing said the Tianjin wafer-reclaim plant's 20 ten-thousand wafers a month is fully loaded, and the Kunshan reclaim expansion plans 40 ten-thousand wafers a month in total, 20 ten-thousand in phase 1.
quarterly_data.figure: parts localisation 70% to 80%; Kunshan reclaim 40 ten-thousand wafers/month planned

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 collective (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Wang Tongqing (H1 2026 collective results briefing): the company has developed CMP, thinning, dicing and edge-polishing tools for HBM and other advanced-packaging needs; the advanced-packaging share of orders has risen markedly and its main products have entered most domestic advanced-packaging customers.
